items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: Yeah, I think Dick was along with her.

ctx.x: Yes, I think somebody did an interview with her, I think backstage here. Back here? Yes, I think Bob Greenwood and Dick Allen.

Did an interview at some point. She was probably playing, that was about the same time George was playing here.
